GET /accounts/{account_id}/realtime/kit/.summary: Fetch details of an active session
GET /accounts/{account_id}/realtime/kit/.description: Returns details of an ongoing active session for the given meeting ID.

activeSessionSuccess.summary: Success response for fetching active session

associated_id.description: ID of the meeting this session is associated with. In the case of V2 meetings, it is always a UUID. In V1 meetings, it is a room name of the form `abcdef-ghijkl`

live_participants.description: number of participants currently in the session

max_concurrent_participants.description: number of maximum participants that were in the session

meeting_display_name.description: Title of the meeting this session belongs to

minutes_consumed.description: number of minutes consumed since the session started

organization_id.description: App id that hosted this session

updated_at.description: timestamp when session was last updated

404.description: Active Session is not found for the given meetingId

POST /accounts/{account_id}/realtime/kit.summary: Kick participants from an active session
POST /accounts/{account_id}/realtime/kit.description: Kicks one or more participants from an active session using their participant IDs. Every connection of each participant is removed from the session.

participant_ids.description: IDs of the participants to kick, as returned when the participants were added to the meeting.

requestBody.description: Request body for kicking participants from an active session.

participants.description: Participants the kick was requested for.

400.description: The meeting ID is not a valid UUID, or `participant_ids` is missing, empty or contains an invalid UUID.
